$comment: #EXP-1725 (IDE adopts the eDE shell): what the IDE's sidebar shows, a pure projection of the host's state, replayed in TS (src/ide.ts) and Rust (uicore-model ide.rs). The document apps/ede/ui/sidebar.json binds the result under /shell/ide; eDE never feeds that path. #EXP-2027 (domain-contract sidebar-tree.json is THE spec; this is its IDE projection): there is NO active team. nav = Home (always, lit on `home`), Needs you (while any, or on its page), Chats, Drafts (while any, or on its page). devices = the Devices row (kind devices, depth 0, group, no nav target: its press folds it, its hover + adds a device; open = devicesOpen, the device-local `openKeys.devices`, absent = open; foldIcon ui-chevron-down open, ui-chevron-right folded) then, while open, one row per device in the host's sidebarDeviceRows order (kind device, depth 1): selected on device:<id> and device-settings:<id>, muted while offline, mark = a teammate's server's team mark, else the green dot (`ide:dot:green`) while online, else null. teams = one List per team in sidebarTeams order: its TEAM row (kind team, depth 0, group, title the name, icon the team mark the host paints, open = the device-local `openKeys.team` flag, absent = open, count = the team's needs-you count (attention), foldIcon, newItems = the team menu's New submenu: Board, Agent, App for owners, Session for every member, sidebar-tree.json teamMenu) then, while open, the team's ONE mixed list: items = its boards, agents, apps and placed root sessions in the host's sidebarTeamItems order, arranged by its `layout` (the member's sidebar_layout rows of section team) through sidebarTree + sidebarRows one level deeper (folder depth 1, an item depth 1, or 2 inside a folder: sidebarTeamRows). An item row carries item = its kind; selected = board:<id> | agent:<id> | app:<id or slug> | a session on chat:<id> or session:<any id of its tree>; gear (the hover gear) = agents and apps for every member, boards for owners, sessions none; an agent's count = rowBadge(unread, needsYou): its unread, at least 1 while it needs you, attention when it does; other items no count. A folder row = title its name (New folder when unnamed), icon ui-folder, never selected, no count, no gear, meta = a FOLDED folder's item count as text, editing = editingFolder's row; a folder with no visible item is not shown EXCEPT the folder being named (sidebar-tree.json New folder), which sits among the placed nodes by its sortOrder. closed = the folder ids this device keeps folded (absent = open). active = Active across every team: each row's teamMark, lit on its root and on any session of its tree. prs (#EXP-1616, repo-page.json): the Pull requests section, repos with live PRs (rows at depth 0, icon ui-repository, selected on repo:<id>), their PRs at their tree depth + 1 (icon null, lit while the chat that opened it is open); hidden while empty. #FEED-232: a row's badge is THE count badge (count = its label, null at zero, 99+ past 99; tone attention | muted, null without a count). screen = the open screen as <kind> or <kind>:<id>. base holds the input every case starts from; a case overrides keys of it. copy = the words (chat-list.json copy.title, needs-you.json copy.entry, sidebar-tree.json copy). tabs: the IDE's tab bar (#EXP-1726, docs/tabbar.json): every open tab in tab order, work tabs and terminals merged in ONE strip (a terminal is a tab like any other: same strip, same close, close others/all and neighbour rules), activeTab = the active key while a tab holds the screen. placement (Danny 2026-11-13): where that strip sits: top in the standalone IDE (macOS, Windows, Linux; the band above the content card that also carries the window controls and the drag), bottom while the IDE runs inside Exponential Desktop (eDE = XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP names Exponential; its taskbar holds the top edge's role), the +N menu opening away from the window edge.
